meta.name: mode-creator
meta.description: Interactively create, install, activate, and verify custom claude-mem modes, including domain-specific observation types, concept tags, optional Telegram alerts, bot setup, worker restart, and startup-context verification. Use this whenever someone asks to customize what claude-mem remembers, create or change a mode, track domain-specific notes, add observation types or tags, or send Telegram notifications for particular memories—even if they do not use the word "mode."

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 自定义 AI 该记住哪些内容,按领域打标签并推送提醒
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果想让 AI 按自己的领域习惯记住要点并在关键记忆上收到提醒
copy.tagline_en: Customize what your assistant remembers, tag notes by domain, and fire alerts
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you want your assistant to remember domain notes and alert you on key ones.

howto.what: 装上后,Claude 会先问你在做什么,据此设计一套 claude-mem 记忆模式(观察类型 + 概念标签),经你确认后安装、重启 worker 并验证它在启动上下文里生效;也能按需开启 Telegram 提醒。
howto.when: 当你想自定义 claude-mem 记住什么、新建或改动模式、添加观察类型或标签,或让特定记忆发 Telegram 通知时触发——即使你没说「mode」这个词。

say.text: 帮我建一个自定义模式,记录每次判决确立的规则和证据冲突
say.note: Claude 会先提问,再给出方案让你确认

say.text: 给 claude-mem 加几个观察类型:设计决策、客户偏好、现场发现
say.note: 确认后才会写入并安装

say.text: 让所有「生产事故」类型的记忆都发 Telegram 提醒

howto.what_en: After install, Claude interviews you about your work, proposes a claude-mem mode (observation types plus concept tags), installs it, restarts the worker, and verifies the mode appears in startup context. Optional Telegram alerts.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you want to customize what claude-mem remembers, create or change a mode, add observation types or tags, or send Telegram alerts for certain memories — even if you never say "mode."

say_en.text: Create a custom mode that records case rulings and evidence conflicts
say_en.note: Claude interviews you first, then shows a proposal to approve

say_en.text: Add observation types for design decisions, client preferences, site findings
say_en.note: Files are written and installed only after you approve

say_en.text: Send a Telegram alert for every production-incident observation
